cost_convention: Effective aggregate trading-cost proxy in bps per unit of absolute one-way traded notional / beginning-period NAV; turnover is not divided by two. Entries, source close/open trades and terminal liquidation are charged. Regular expiry-roll activity is not yet modeled separately.
trade_rule: Existing same-direction positions: retain within relative band, otherwise trade to nearest edge. New entries, zero targets and sign changes execute at target. Hard risk and exposure limits override the band.
limit_timing: Monthly decision points, after beginning-of-month trading costs; capital and forecasts can change between rebalances. Proportional reductions only; do not enlarge positions to reach the risk ceiling.
lecture_source: ORIE5260 Lecture 5, slides 9, 12–16, 26–27 and 36 (reference only; not a runtime input)

source_selection.rule: RL until ER has 36 consecutive observed monthly returns ending at least two months before the holding month, then ER permanently. Never choose source from current realized availability.

autocorrelation_hac: At return lag k, use k Bartlett HAC lags on calendar-spaced scores, with n/(n-2) correction and t(n-2) intervals.
risk_model_note: correlation_shrinkage (0.5) is the rolling covariance baseline, kept as the reference; risk_model.correlation_shrinkage is the DCC-GARCH value (notebooks/risk_model_estimators.ipynb: with the rescale the level matters little, 0.05 to 0.1 recommended). rescale: past-only calibration scale, window and minimum in months. Set risk_model to {"type": "rolling"} for the baseline.
trend_signal_note: notebooks/trend_measures.ipynb, section 5 and the summary table. In-sample class-portfolio rankings, not validated out of sample. COMM, FI and EQ keep the baseline 12-month sum; FX averages a 3-month and a 12-month sum, a blend that was not itself in the notebook's grid.
